req.title: Create task
req.statement: The system shall create a new task and respond with HTTP 201 and the created task body when POST /tasks/ receives a valid TaskCreate payload.
expected_outcomes: response body includes id, title, completed=false

doc.reasoning: The suite covers: (1) EP positive — a typical valid TaskCreate payload returns HTTP 201 with correct body fields including id, title, completed=False; (2) NEG — missing required 'title' field returns HTTP 422; (3) BVA — title at exact max length (100 chars) is accepted; (4) BVA — title at 101 chars (one over max) is rejected; (5) DT — completed field defaults to False when omitted; (6) NEG — empty string title is rejected; (7) BVA — description at exact max length (500 chars) is accepted; (8) NEG — description exceeding 500 chars is rejected. Each test uses an in-process TestClient, asserts exact status codes and body fields, and is designed to kill constant-mutation, comparison-flip, and boolean-negation mutants.

tests.name: test_create_task_valid_payload_returns_201_with_body
actions: POST /tasks/ with {title: 'Read chapter 5', description: 'Signal pulse ember', completed: false}
trace: R-TASK-001: system shall respond HTTP 201 with created task body
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_create_task_valid_payload_returns_201_with_body():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "Read chapter 5", "description": "Signal pulse ember", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["id"] > 0
    assert body["title"] == "Read chapter 5"
    assert body["completed"] is False
    assert body["description"] == "Signal pulse ember"
    assert "created_at" in body
    assert body["created_at"] is not None

test_create_task_valid_payload_returns_201_with_body()
